title: DelegateGroup - Tooling API
description: Represents a Delegate Group for queries. This object is available in Tooling API version 57.0 and later.

DeveloperName.description: The unique developer name for the delegate group.

IsLoginAccessEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsLoginAccessEnabled.description: Indicates login access is enabled for the developer group. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The label for the developer group.
